meta.title: Tom's Poster Afternoon
meta.textType: time: the hours of the day

paragraphs: Hi, I am Tom. Today I am at home. At one o'clock, I sit at my desk. I have a pen and a pencil. I draw a poster for my room. It is a big red robot. I like it. Pip sleeps under the desk. He is a good dog.

At two o'clock, Lily comes in. She has a doll. "Can I draw too?" asks Lily. "Yes, you can," I say. Lily has a pencil. She is happy. She draws her doll next to the robot. We draw and draw. At three o'clock, Mom looks at the poster. "It is beautiful!" says Mom.

At four o'clock, we put the poster on the wall. It is next to the window. It is very nice. At six o'clock, we have dinner. Pip eats too. Mom smiles. Do you have a poster in your room? What is on your desk? I like my room. It is a happy room!
text.summary: Tom tells us about an afternoon at home. He and Lily make a poster at the desk and put it on the wall.
